It is probably the best option, since there are some pretty MV bats out there.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
fizzyquest said:
it didn't really work (glitchy).
Click to expand...
Stuff like that is not useful when you're trying to get help. Just saying "didn't work" or "glitchy" tells us zero things about the problem you had. Specific descriptions and screenshots tell us things.
There's no such thing as sizing being too small or too big, so long as the format of the image is correct. That's why Avery told you to read the instructions; in MZ, click Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Asset Standards.
The second to last bat, for example, is in the wrong format for a character sheet for MZ. You would have to use an image editor to get rid of one of the columns.
You also need to make sure, according to the instructions I referenced above, you're naming the files correctly.

posts.author: ATT_Turan

TheAM-Dol said:
The walk sprite is formatted correctly, so what is the problem?
Click to expand...
It's not quite - it has the correct number of rows and columns, but there's a ton of extra space on the interior of the cels that isn't there at the outside edges, so the engine is going to calculate the cels as being in the middle of the images.
